aspect: Detention in order to build the case
description: Arraigo permitted holding a person while evidence was gathered, rather than gathering evidence in order to hold them.

aspect: It was the subject of sustained international criticism
description: UN bodies and the Inter-American system repeatedly criticised the figure as incompatible with presumption of innocence, and its scope has been narrowed by successive rulings.

aspect: Weeks of detention leave no conviction and no record to clear
description: A man released without charge has lost the job and the weeks, and has no finding to appeal because there was never a finding.
energy_note: Nothing to appeal, because nothing was ever decided.

description: He is released with no charge after five and a half weeks. Nobody apologises, nobody explains, and there is no document recording that he was innocent - because nobody ever formally said he was not. The job is gone and the landlord has let the room.
energy_note: Released without a piece of paper saying he did nothing.
